scripts.vault:backup: pnpm run build:core && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js backup
scripts.vault:verify: pnpm run build:core && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js verify
scripts.vault:restore: pnpm run build:core && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js restore
scripts.migrate:vault: pnpm run build:core && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.config:check: pnpm run build:core && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js config-check
